name: Liquidity Risk
description: Regulatory and internal liquidity metrics, buffers, and funding concentration.

metrics.name: lcr
metrics.description: High-quality liquid assets divided by 30-day stressed net outflows

metrics.name: nsfr
metrics.description: Available stable funding divided by required stable funding

metrics.name: hqla
metrics.description: High-quality liquid assets after haircuts at a point in time

metrics.name: survival_horizon
metrics.description: Days until the buffer is exhausted under stress

conventions.rule: Liquidity at one entity may not be transferable to another; do not assume consolidated totals are available everywhere.
HQLA levels (1, 2A, 2B) carry different haircuts and caps; state the level.

insight_rules.reason: Attribute LCR change via HQLA and outflow changes.

caveats.text: Reported LCR is often a period average; daily values are more volatile.

chart_conventions.rule: Show the ratio with the regulatory minimum as a reference line.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
